item.title: Permanent route change: 621 and 698 serving Ottawa high schools
item.description:
February 27 2026 -

Starting March 2, service on school routes 621 and 698 will be withdrawn or modified. Affected schools have notified the students impacted by these changes with details on alternative service.

Students can use the Travel Planner to plan their trip on OC Transpo buses, or visit the Ottawa Student Transportation website for information on yellow school bus service.

Route 621

  • All trips on this route will be removed
  • Transportation to Lester B. Pearson High School and Gloucester High School will be provided by yellow school bus going forward
  • Service to Colonel By High School is available with OC Transpo regular bus service

Route 698

  • Trips serving St Patrick’s High School will be shortened to no longer operate east of Conroy Road
  • Service east of Conroy Road will be replaced by yellow school bus service
  • The trip starting at Blohm / Forestglade at 7:40 am will be removed
  • One of the trips departing St Patrick’s High School at 2:44 pm will be removed
  • The remaining three morning and three afternoon trips are expected to provide sufficient capacity
  • These changes do not impact Route 698 service for Ridgemont High School

item.title: Stop impacts: Blair Station stop I relocation (UPDATED)
item.description:
October 10 2025 -

Updated on Friday, February 27, 2026

From 11:00 am on Tuesday, October 14 and continuing throughfall 2026*, stop I at Blair Station will be temporarily closed. This closure is due to construction work being performed on the north bus platform, as part of the Blair Station Elevator Replacement Project.

Impacts

  • Service for routes 12, 15, 23, 24, 26, 39, N39, and 42 will be relocated two stops east to stop G during the work period.
  • No pedestrian access to north bus platform from the west side of the station. Use the accessible walkway along north platform East.
  • No impact to north bus platform elevator or stairs

What else to expect

Customers should expect a heavier presence of construction activity along the pedestrian walkway at the station.

Starting March 2, 2026, part of the north bus platform and the lower level east doors will be closed for several months to allow work on the new elevator system. Customers will use the adjacent south doors to access stops F, G, and H using a temporary platform installed next to the existing platform. This will not affect the stop locations or service.

Other minor impacts to platforms and walkways on certain workdays may occur. Construction crews and flaggers will guide customers as required.

*Date to-be-confirmed
